title: One Hundred Years of Solitude
author: Gabriel García Márquez
protagonist: The Buendía family (collective, across seven generations)

beats.event: José Arcadio kills Prudencio Aguilar after a cockfight
Dreams of Macondo, a city of mirrors
Founds Macondo by the river after wandering the jungle
Macondo grows into a town of marvels
Gypsies visit each year with new wonders
Melquíades befriends José Arcadio, who withdraws into obsession
José Arcadio goes mad, is tied to a chestnut tree
A rigged election drives Aureliano Buendía into civil war
Aureliano becomes an iconic revolutionary, fighting for years
The railroad arrives with new technology and foreigners
American fruit company plants its banana plantation
Colombian army massacres thousands of striking workers
José Arcadio Segundo, the only survivor, finds all evidence erased
Amaranta Úrsula and her nephew Aureliano begin their incest
Their child is born with the tail of a pig
Macondo is scoured from the earth
